## 6. QA gate

- [ ] Every number traces to a verified F-row
- [ ] Tone law: no menace in the image, voiceover or copy
- [ ] Number composited as a rendered plate; no AI text in the frame
- [ ] Hook in 2 seconds with the number visible
- [ ] Tension object and plate inside the 3:4 grid crop
- [ ] Subtitles burned in, clear of the platform UI
- [ ] Within word budget; numbers spoken correctly
- [ ] No buy/sell language; "Not investment advice" in the caption
- [ ] AI labels set on Instagram and TikTok
- [ ] Tracked links in place
- [ ] Kanchan approved
